Example league for playoff seeding

seeding_example.Rd

A small league used in the examples and tests: 13 East teams in three divisions and 6 West teams in two, with a few games, so that some teams tie on winning percentage.

Usage

seeding_example

Format

A list with the inputs of compute_playoff_seeding():

meta

abbreviation, division, and conference for each team.

standings

Standings with Winning Pct.

scores_tidy

One row per team per game.

Examples

str(seeding_example, max.level = 1)
#> List of 3
#>  $ meta       : tibble [19 × 3] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ standings  : tibble [19 × 8] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>  $ scores_tidy: tibble [4 × 4] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
